hook: Your cooktop can boil water with paper under the pan.
title: Boiling Water on Paper Without Burning It
description:
An induction cooktop does not heat itself. It makes a magnetic field that heats the metal pan directly, so a sheet of paper under the pan does not catch fire.

Series: Tech That Sounds Fake.
comment_prompt: Would you try this? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Put paper under a pan on an induction cooktop.
scenes.headline: PAPER UNDER THE PAN

scenes.narration: The water boils. The paper does not catch fire.
scenes.headline: WATER BOILS

scenes.narration: The cooktop does not make heat itself.
scenes.headline: COOKTOP STAYS COOL

scenes.narration: It makes a magnetic field instead.
scenes.headline: A MAGNETIC FIELD

scenes.narration: That field heats the metal pan directly.
scenes.headline: THE PAN HEATS ITSELF

scenes.narration: The paper just sits there, unburnt.
scenes.headline: PAPER JUST SITS

scenes.narration: Your cooktop boils water on paper.
scenes.headline: WATER ON PAPER

scenes.headline: NEXT: FLOATING LAKE
